title: Agents ask Buchanan to influence Gorbachev, and his words end up in the speech ending communism

tellings.quote: the speech where they ended um communism, the words in that speech were the words that I'd been pumping into him.

plain: In 1991, agents asked Army Sergeant Lyn Buchanan, working at Fort Meade, an Army base in Maryland, to influence Mikhail Gorbachev, the Soviet leader, with his mind. Buchanan says that when Gorbachev gave the speech that ended communism, the words in it were the very words he had been 'pumping into him.' If true, it would mean a mental technique helped shape the end of the Soviet Union.
